title: MT1 scenario file, format 1.4
description: docs/SCENARIOS.md is the prose. Every leaf carries x-target: the symbolic path of docs/lockstep/state.schema.json it writes, or 'NEW:<name>' for a target the loader must add. Coordinates are map cells [row, col]; the loader writes t.row = 2*row, t.col = 2*col (half-cell units, proved by the starport shops poke (6,102) = cell (3,51)).

format.description: 1.1 adds NPCs/encounters; 1.2 adds ship; 1.3 adds save; 1.4 adds squad, ground, place.starport_area, member attr / grenades, pack item cell (M8); 1.5 adds party.damage (the docked ship's damage). Earlier files remain valid. Nonempty ship requires 1.2; npc/encounter require 1.1 or later; save requires 1.3; 1.4 fields require 1.4 (validator rules).

menu.description: Testing-scenarios menu entry as "Group / Label"; a file without it is not listed

row.description: test-sheet row this scenario starts (purpose = test), e.g. 'M4B 7'

base.description: starting 0xF86 block before any field applies: the Get Started Quick block (DEFAULT.SAV + T 822C). a [save] scenario (format 1.3) starts from a remaster save instead and may not set base (validator rule)

place.description: applied as one action through the original's own world entry (init_world BE15 / enter_area B164, the path the F10 debug teleport and level doors use), then the party cell; never by poking t.level alone

outdoors.x-target: derived (map name G1/G2/G3 = true, INSIDE = false); checked, never written

dark.x-target: declares a dark start on level 1 / 2 without a light on (the room is drawn dim); otherwise such a placement is refused

starport_area.x-target: NEW:t.starport_area (DS:6D20: true writes 0 = inside the starport area, false writes 1 = outside)
starport_area.description: format 1.4. Inside the starport area the 1990 game refuses Break (ASBUILT Break, 615E) and dropping ('Littering in the Starport area is severly prohibited!', drop_item 9190). Outdoor maps only

damage.description: format 1.5: the ship's damage while docked, as the starport Repairs desk reads it (C2..C5 the four sections, C6 the hull); the same bytes [ship] damage writes at take-off, now on a ground start

cargo.description: slot bytes as the game stores them, slot 0 first, rest zeroed; 4 = water (lockstep ref 02 step 398)

slot.description: character record index (0..4 party, 5..7 recruit slots)

present.description: false removes the member from the party (alive bit cleared); slots 0..4 only

attr.x-target: party.chars[i].attr[0..5] (char+0x14: Str Dex End Int Edu Soc)
attr.description: format 1.4: characteristics, only the ones named change

grenades.description: format 1.4: the built-in grenade counts the T menu throws (E / C / R), 0..9 each

replace.description: true: free every object this member holds first, then fill; false: keep, fill free cells

hands.x-target: inventory cells 21, 22 (char+0xF6, +0xF8; schema names armor, weapon)

armor.x-target: inventory cell 20 (char+0xF4; state schema name 'actor'): the cell CG 1D0A equips armour into (docs/decode/cg_1d0a_build_party.md). Cell 19 (char+0xF2) is not exposed in format 1: role unproved

hostility.x-target: NEW:t.monsters[i].attitude (low 2 bits) for every record on place.level
hostility.description: as_map = W.DAT values; all_hostile = low bits 0; none = low bits 2 (the peaceful value W.DAT uses)

record.description: W.DAT object record of the area, 1-based (t.monsters[record-1])

present.x-target: NEW:npc_remove (false = gone: cell occupancy cleared, npc_bits set, no reward)

hits.x-target: NEW:t.monsters[i].hits (mon+0x0A; hit_npc 1B4B:1DA3 damage counter, 0xFF = invulnerable is refused)

seeds.description: srand arguments, LOCKSTEP.md section 5 semantics: the k-th srand of that program after the scenario applies takes this value instead of the BIOS tick word

T.x-target: rng.T (seeded: state = value at apply, before the first poll)

STARTUP.x-target: NEW:pending_srand.STARTUP (unused by a scenario boot; kept for format parity)

vehicle.x-target: NEW:vehicle (rent_vehicle 3A05 effects without payment: picture load into DS:62B0, place_vehicle, then board)

boarded.x-target: t.vehicle (DS:6C3B = type when boarded, else 0) + NEW:t.vehicle_rented DS:6D31 = 1

starport.description: M5 fields. Shop stock in MT1 is not a table: it follows the world's tech and law (weapons_store 17F08 and armor_shop 1896C take header f15/law), so stock is set through tech/law

npc.description: format 1.1: NPCs placed by ROLE from data/npcs.toml (docs/NPCS.md). Each takes one monster record slot of the area

encounter.description: format 1.1: encounter definitions for this scenario (D-O3, D-O3b, D-O4, D-O10); the game's own story fights live in data/encounters.toml with the same shape plus `where`

ship.description: format 1.2. Party fields apply in a pre-S checkpoint; other fields are validated and pending until the S runtime exists.

ground.x-target: NEW:place_object (1B4B:01FA as drop_item 9190 places a dropped item: the ground-object table party+0x602 and the cell's object chain cell[0] >> 1)
ground.description: format 1.4: items lying on cells of place.level (the P16 ground tray reads them)

squad.description: format 1.4 (M8A squad layer, product mode only; --faithful refuses every scenario). Nothing here enters the save block: it is the squad state P1 / P2 / P6 / P21 hold beside the 1990 state (DESIGN.md P9b).

mode.x-target: NEW:squad.broken (DS:6D0E combat flag; walkers placed by break_party 615E unless travellers give cells)

selected.description: party slot of the selected Traveller ('Traveller 1' = 0)

acted.x-target: NEW:squad.unit[slot].move_left = 0, attack_left = false (both pips spent this round)

attacked.x-target: NEW:squad.unit[slot].attack_left = false (Attack pip spent, Move left)

route.x-target: walker[slot] route bytes (+0x16 length, +0x17.. directions; f32f0.c:52-58): the standing move order, each cell next to the one before

encounter.x-target: NEW:encounter_state (P1: active id, round, side to act, surprise; written by a 1.4 scenario, read back as in 1.1)

id.description: an encounter of data/encounters.toml on this level or of this file's [[encounter]]

to_act.description: the side whose turn it is

surprised.description: the surprise result of round 1 (RULES 1.2), fixed instead of rolled

role.description: a data/npcs.toml role replacing the mapped one for this record, or "none" = no entry (R-9 derived fallback)

skills.description: Players' Manual skill name = level, over the role's sheet (e.g. Tactics = 2)

hits.description: product-mode hits left (the role's a + b pool); 0 = dead (M8-3)

engaged.description: the NPC has engaged the party in the active encounter

alerted_rounds.description: D-O3 ALERTED with this many rounds of clock left

speed.description: its movement last round: 0 stood, 1 walked, 2 ran (the target-movement DM, RULES 2.3)

save.description: format 1.3 (M7). The scenario IS the save: the loader restores this remaster save (mt1::save, magic MT1SAVE) as Continue Old Game does, and takes no other section (validator rule). The sample is generated by the exe, never committed (it holds the player's T.DAT data).

file.description: path of a .mtsav relative to this scenario file, confined to its folder: no absolute path, no drive letter, no .. segment (a shared scenario can only name a file beside itself)

space_marker.description: D8: five signed words, DS:3AB0 + 10*i. Direction uses the game's compass order: 0 E, 1 NE, 2 N, 3 NW, 4 W, 5 SW, 6 S, 7 SE; -1 inactive. 7CF8 stores active=-1 or 100+direction.

world.description: party+007, STP world byte minus one; 255 = no world after jump. Defaults to place.area

orbit.description: zero-based STP object index; -1 = free flight. Not the STP orbit-radius byte. Checked against system object count

position.description: signed system-map coordinates; omission uses D0D/39AF placement

heading.description: 4FCB game compass order: 0 E, 1 NE, 2 N, 3 NW, 4 W, 5 SW, 6 S, 7 SE. Writes heading=90+n, direction=1+n, view_heading=n

fuel_scoops.description: 4FCB: the ship scoops fuel at rest at a gas giant only when both bits are set; false clears them (the 1990 then says unable to process atmosphere)

jump_drive.description: 3F5: 0 none, 1 Jump-1, 2 Jump-2; 3 would index past the two jump-link rows. Preserve other bits, including scoop hardware

programs.description: AC..BF symbolic computer slots: id | (loaded ? 0x80 : 0) | (running ? 0x20 : 0), per 121C/A7B. Empty slot = {id:0,loaded:false,running:false}; remainder zeroed. Undecoded bits 0x10/0x40 are unwritable

sections.description: C2..C5 in save-schema order; no invented component names

hull.description: C6; C7..C9 remain outside this format

screen.description: Enter 4FCB / 3F5 / AF17 after initialization and pending writes; jump requires orbit=-1, station requires station

station.description: AF17/MT1CTL: pilot=10, gunner_1=11, gunner_2=12, computer=13, engineering=14, comms=15, crew=17. Requires screen=station, sets station_active=1

ships.description: D8 table = 18 records x 10 bytes. Replacement prefix, ship_count = length; remaining rows become {x:0,y:0,active:-1,dstx:0,dsty:0}. [] clears encounters

encounter.description: one-based selected group; requires a live entry in ship.ships

encounter_group.description: Replace selected group's four tactical enemies through 720F/7302/740E, then 6D09 placement. Needed because markers alone do not define hostile ships. Clear four records first; unused slots stay empty.

rect.description: [[row0, col0], [row1, col1]] inclusive, on the encounter's level; row0 <= row1, col0 <= col1

npc.x-target: NEW:npc_spawn (writes one monster record DS:63F4 + 0x2E*k as init_world BE15 builds it: id, state = level, home x/y and x/y, type, picture, hp, level, flags, weapon, ammo; plus the squad-layer NPC sheet from the role)

id.description: handle for encounter participants; unique in the file

at.x-target: monster home x/y (0x03/0x05) and x/y (0x20/0x22), both x2

record.description: the area's record slot this NPC takes over (its W.DAT NPC is replaced for this run). Omitted: the loader appends a slot (DS:6418 + 1); the validator refuses that when the area already has 32 records

ammo.description: total rounds; default = (clips + 1) x the weapon's rounds per clip (TRAV.ITM 0x28), capped at 255

hits.description: 1990 hp (the --faithful skill input); the product uses the role's hits a/b. Default 8 x the role's best skill for its weapon, min 8

leash.description: wander radius in tiles around `at` (default 0 = stands)

rect.description: area_entry: any Traveller (or the grouped party) stands on a cell inside, including where a scenario or a level entry puts them

flag.description: story_flag: an NPC id's kill bit (party+8) or reward bit (party+0x3A), or a floor-item spawn's taken bit (save +0x6C): all 1990 save bits

npc_id.description: story_flag killed / rewarded: the W.DAT NPC id (record 0x00)

spawn.description: story_flag spawn_taken: the bit index (header spawn_base + i)

state.description: dialogue: fires when that record's conversation state (0x1A) becomes this value

item.description: object_taken: TRAV.ITM id picked up on this level

encounter.x-target: NEW:encounter_defs (squad-layer table, read by P1 at level entry; never in the save block: D-O10 forbids saving while one is active, and a finished story fight stays finished through the 1990 kill bits of its NPCs)

start.description: sight = D-O3 (a willing armed NPC within the radius with line of sight, or a hostile verb by the party); scripted = the trigger

end.description: open = ends after n_rounds closing with no willing armed NPC in sight; locked = only when every hostile participant is destroyed, the party is down, or a Traveller reaches the escape zone

escape_zone.description: locked only: a conscious Traveller ending a turn inside leaves the fight (the encounter ends for the party; alerted NPCs stay alerted)

boundary.description: which NPCs take turns: within `radius` squares of a Traveller (the default), on the 1990 screen (within 6 rows and 11 columns of any Traveller; the engine's own data-less fight), inside `rect`, or the whole level

auto_break.description: D-O4: break the party at start where the 1990 rule allows

allow_save.description: D-O10: false = Save is refused while this encounter is active. Format 1.4 (M8C save-anywhere, O-21) allows true: a save mid-encounter restores mid-encounter (validator: true needs format 1.4; data/encounters.toml keeps false until save-anywhere enables it)

participants.description: record numbers of the area and/or [[npc]] ids; a locked fight ends when every hostile participant is destroyed

alerted_rounds.description: D-O3 ALERTED: an NPC that engaged keeps approaching at exploration pace until dead, fled, or out of the radius this many rounds; while one is alerted on the level: no healing, resting or time-skip (number by play-test)

surprise.description: roll = RULES 1.2 Leader + Recon task by the attacking side; attackers / defenders = that side has surprise without a roll; none = nobody

attacker.description: scripted starts: the side making the first hostile move (it rolls for surprise); sight starts decide it at run time

where.description: data/encounters.toml only: the level this story fight belongs to

source.description: where the fight comes from (Clue Book page, ASBUILT section)

encounter_file.description: data/encounters.toml: the game's own story fights

item.x-target: party.objects[n].id/qty/charge (a free record, id 0xFF, allocated as alloc_object 179B2 does) + the inventory cell = n+1

name.description: must equal the TRAV.ITM name for id (validator check; readability only)

charge.x-target: party.objects[n].charge (object+2: rounds in the weapon = chamber state, charges)

cell.description: format 1.4, pack items only: the pack cell (default: the first free one, in file order). Lets a row name 'slot 4'
